page_title: ATA 0-0 JUV | Atalanta v Juventus 01/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Daniele Chiffi shows a yellow card to Emil Holm (Atalanta) for his blatant foul.
90+4' Emil Holm (Atalanta) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
90+3' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies slightly over, almost brushing the crossbar.
90+2' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Filip Kostic (Juventus), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets underneath the ball and it flies high over the bar.

89' Luis Muriel (Atalanta) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Wojciech Szczesny pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
88' Luis Muriel (Atalanta) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
88' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
86' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to substitute Matteo Ruggeri and he is replaced by Mitchel Bakker (Atalanta).
84' Substitution. Timothy Weah (Juventus) has come on for Weston McKennie.
84' Substitution. Bremer makes way for Daniele Rugani (Juventus).
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Emil Holm (Atalanta) comes onto the pitch so that Davide Zappacosta can be given a rest.
82' Gian Piero Gasperini prepares a substitution. Charles De Ketelaere is replaced by Mario Pasalic (Atalanta).
81' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Wojciech Szczesny, who smothers the ball.

79' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar.
79' Luis Muriel (Atalanta) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
77' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.

77' Luis Muriel (Atalanta) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Daniele Chiffi blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
75' Moise Kean comes off the pitch to be replaced by Kenan Yildiz (Juventus).
74' Atalanta have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
74' Luis Muriel (Atalanta) takes a mid-range free kick, but Wojciech Szczesny stops the ball from reaching the top left corner by tipping it onto the post. Great save!
73' Atalanta have been awarded a free kick just outside the penalty area, in a dangerous position.
73' Danilo (Juventus) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Daniele Chiffi signals.
72' Rafael Toloi (Atalanta) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Daniele Chiffi stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
70' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Luis Muriel (Atalanta). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
69' Danilo (Juventus) sends a long cross over to Federico Chiesa, but Juan Musso comes forward to gather the ball.
68' Substitution. Andrea Cambiaso makes his way off the pitch and Filip Kostic (Juventus) comes on as his replacement.
68' Substitution. Fabio Miretti (Juventus) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Nicolo Fagioli walks off.
67' Rafael Toloi (Atalanta) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
65' Here is a change. Giorgio Scalvini is going off and Gian Piero Gasperini gives the last tactical orders to Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta).
65' A substitution has been made. Ademola Lookman goes off and Luis Muriel (Atalanta) comes on.
65' That was close by Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.
64' Rafael Toloi (Atalanta) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
61' Atalanta failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
60' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
59' Weston McKennie (Juventus) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
59' The referee blows his whistle as Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) was too aggressive in his challenge.
58' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is penalised for a foul. Daniele Chiffi had a clear view and blows his whistle.
58' Rafael Toloi (Atalanta) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
57' Great teamplay by Atalanta as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
53' Tempers flare after a clattering challenge by Danilo (Juventus), who receives a yellow card from the referee. It could have been worse for him!
52' Chance! Federico Chiesa (Juventus) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards the top of the net, but Juan Musso is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
51' Ederson (Atalanta) runs onto a pass and from the edge of the box tries his luck with a dipping shot. Unfortunately for him, the effort fizzes just over the bar.
49' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
48' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) attempts to find Charles De Ketelaere, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
46' Danilo (Juventus) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Daniele Chiffi blows for a foul.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) was quite harsh and Daniele Chiffi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
44' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

44' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Juventus.
42' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but Juan Musso comes off his line to gather the ball.
41' Weston McKennie (Juventus) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
38' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
36' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for a foul.
35' Moise Kean (Juventus) drills a low shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads towards the left post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic save.
34' Half-chance! Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) plays a pass into the box, but Wojciech Szczesny reacts well to snuff out the attack.
33' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) sends a long ball forward to Teun Koopmeiners, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
31' Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes to the right side of the target, but Juan Musso keeps it out with an amazing save.
31' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

30' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Juventus.
29' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) takes just a short run up and his weak free kick from the edge of the box is blocked by the defensive wall.
29' Rafael Toloi (Atalanta) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. Juventus have a free kick from a promising distance.
28' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
25' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
23' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) tackles a bit over-zealously and Daniele Chiffi blows for a foul.
21' Moise Kean (Juventus) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Federico Chiesa.
19' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
19' Rough tackle by Weston McKennie (Juventus). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
16' The foul by Moise Kean (Juventus) was seen by Daniele Chiffi who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
15' Great chance! Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) controls a rebound inside the box. He only has the keeper to beat, but his shot flies a whisker wide of the right post.
15' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) is caught off guard a bit when the ball lands at his feet, causing him to rush a first-time shot that is easily blocked by an opposition player.
13' A lofted cross from Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
11' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
10' Neat link-up play between Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) and Giorgio Scalvini, but Wojciech Szczesny reads the game well and the move breaks down.
9' Moise Kean (Juventus) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
6' Ederson (Atalanta) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
4' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
3' Neat passing move from Atalanta in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
1' A cross from Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Atalanta will have the kick-off.
Daniele Chiffi got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
